selection_rule: First 8 SHA-ordered admitted train displacement candidates; no policy results or held-out clips used.
acceleration_method: central3/central5 derivatives of saved interval qvel; two boundary frames excluded per end
limits: Inverse forces describe the exact saved pose/velocity and finite-difference acceleration under MuJoCo's soft contact model. They are not an optimized contact-force allocation, a proof that approximate tracking is impossible, or manufacturer hardware limits. The 1/10/30 mm proximity and 0.05 m/s slip thresholds are descriptive diagnostics. No reference, reward, control, training source, checkpoint or budget is changed.
